response.sql: SELECT s.zoneregistry AS site_reference, s.insurstat AS insurance_status, COUNT(*) AS record_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS FLOAT) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scanconservation sc INNER JOIN sites s2 ON sc.zoneref = s2.zoneregistry) AS fraction FROM scanconservation sc INNER JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat ORDER BY fraction DESC, s.insurstat IS NULL LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The fraction denominator should be the total count of all matched conservation records (from the INNER JOIN), not the total records in scanconservation table before matching.
